column1: • Size range: Child 4 Years through Child 14 Years, plus Adult M through Adult 5XL.

Blue Monstera Citrus brings a crisp tropical palette to matching family style. Saturated blue leaves, airy pale-blue fronds, orange fruit, and small winged accents keep the white-ground shirt bright and distinctive without changing the easy button-up silhouette.

• Tropical blue print: Vivid monstera leaves and pale fronds stand out against the clean white ground.
• Orange accents: Fruit motifs add warm contrast throughout the blue botanical pattern.
• Warm-weather details: Short sleeves and a button front make the shirt easy to layer or wear on its own.
• Single-shirt clarity: Each selected variant is one shirt
